title: Prospective active-irrigation temporal acceptance contract

evidence_base.RM20: certificate decomposition shows forcing discontinuity is dominant but not sufficient to explain the inherited-budget failure
evidence_base.RM21: retry-level provenance repaired the misleading max diagnostic interpretation
evidence_base.RM23: independent same-horizon one-step versus two-half endpoint difference is 0.04638380228385586 cm; four-quarter refinement is unavailable because the second 2.16 s substep fails
evidence_base.RM24: the inherited F-GC44 1e-5 cm budget has no authority for transfer to active irrigation

purpose: Define what must be independently justified before an active-irrigation SWAP transaction can be admitted. This contract deliberately does not choose thresholds from the RM13/RM23 outcomes.

required_fidelity_dimensions.reference: same-horizon independently refined or independently solved trajectory
required_fidelity_dimensions.reason: accepted SWAP state is hydrological memory for later management and groundwater response

required_fidelity_dimensions.reference: exact transfer ledger plus hydrological state response
required_fidelity_dimensions.reason: Ribasim allocation is not identical to physical realization
the triangle must preserve the already admitted groundwater action/reaction semantics
conservation remains a hard gate independent of temporal fidelity

reference_rules: A refinement reference must cover the same physical horizon; shorter solves from the same origin are not by themselves an error reference.
If refinement loses nonlinear solvability before an asymptotic regime is demonstrated, the finest converged trajectory may be reported but must not be called exact.

A production threshold must come from an application requirement, independent validation authority, or a separately preregistered numerical-accuracy requirement. It may not be selected after observing RM23 to make RM13B pass.
Forcing discontinuities may have separate history semantics only after rollback/restart-safe qualification; RM20 alone does not authorize reseeding.
permitted_next_actions: Obtain or derive an independent quantitative temporal-fidelity requirement for the intended hydrological application.
Develop a more robust independent same-horizon reference integration only if it does not change the production solver merely to manufacture a pass.
Continue non-admission architectural composition tests only when clearly labelled research/diagnostic and without weakening the production temporal gate.
prohibited_actions: Set the new head tolerance just above 0.04638380228385586 cm.
Use the RM23 one-versus-two-half difference itself as the acceptance threshold.
Disable the production temporal gate and call the resulting triangle qualified.
Infer that smaller timesteps are safer despite the four-quarter nonlinear failure.
